customManagers.description: Keep exact-pinned global npm installs in GitHub Actions run: steps current (Issue #3951). A run: step is not a manifest, so no built-in manager sees these pins.

packageRules.description: Deno/JSR deps are governed by bump-deps.sh --minimum-dependency-age and deno.json minimumDependencyAge; disable Renovate's deno manager so the two windows cannot race.

Internal first-party code ships with no embargo (Issue #1613 classification). null is Renovate's documented no-embargo value; the schema types minimumReleaseAge as string|null, so "0" and false are both invalid.
